slides.text: Know this **before** your first trade. It decides your position size.

slides.title: The same 10-point move
head: Contract

slides.text: Micros are **one tenth** of the full contract. Same chart, a tenth of the risk.

points.b: Size from the stop, not from a feeling
points.t: Decide the dollars you risk, then compute contracts.
Learn with a tenth of the risk on the same market.

points.b: NQ moves more points than ES
points.t: Same stop in points is not the same risk.

slides.title: Know the point value before you click.
slides.text: Points × dollars per point × contracts = the money on the line.
